text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome back to the weigh-in! In this corner, an entry built by your humble announcer, who is also the judge, so please, hold your boos. She passed every automated check, but her realism score comes from the owner, not from me. This time she ditched those spiky made-up eyelashes for natural ones, softened the hairline, and fixed a brain whose timers kept carrying over between rounds. Standing one point seven three meters, the patient counter-striker in terracotta, give it up for CLAUDE!
